      • put

        public void put(String pkey,
                AuthCacheValue value)
        从接口复制的说明: AuthCache
        Put an entry in the cache. pkey is a string specified as follows: A:[B:]C:D:E[:F] Between 4 and 6 fields separated by ":" where the fields have the following meaning: A is "s" or "p" for server or proxy authentication respectively B is optional and is the AuthScheme, e.g. BASIC, DIGEST, NTLM, etc C is either "http" or "https" D is the hostname E is the port number F is optional and if present is the realm Generally, two entries are created for each AuthCacheValue, one including the realm and one without the realm. Also, for some schemes (digest) multiple entries may be created with the same pkey, but with a different path value in the AuthCacheValue.
        指定者:
        put 在接口中 AuthCache

      • get

        public AuthCacheValue get(String pkey,
                          String skey)
        从接口复制的说明: AuthCache
        Get an entry from the cache based on pkey as described above, but also using a pathname (skey) and the cache must return an entry if skey is a sub-path of the AuthCacheValue.path field.

      • remove

        public void remove(String pkey,
                   AuthCacheValue entry)
        从接口复制的说明: AuthCache
        remove the entry from the cache whose pkey is specified and whose path is equal to entry.path. If entry is null then all entries with the same pkey should be removed.
        指定者:
        remove 在接口中 AuthCache
